consent.body: {{app}} records the room through the microphone. In many places everyone present has to agree first, so tell them before you start.

items.calls: Phones can’t record calls. Use speakerphone and Room mode.
items.local: Audio stays on this phone unless you choose to send it.
items.tell: {{app}} reminds you before every recording and can copy a short message to send.

consent.title: Tell people before you record

models.body: Speech models (about {{size}}) download once and stay on this phone.
models.error: The download stopped. What was already downloaded is kept.
models.title: Download the speech models
models.wifiWaiting: Waiting for Wi-Fi. The download continues when you connect.
models.optional: This phone records only, so the speech models are optional.

processing.footer: You can change this later in Settings.

onboarding.loadError: Couldn’t load your setup. Try again.

consent.body: {{app}} records the room, so everyone present should know. Copy a short message to send them.
consent.title: Tell everyone you’re recording

error.micInUse: The microphone is in use. Finish your voice recording first.
error.callActive: A phone call is active. Read the notice first.
error.diskLow: Not enough storage to record. Free up space and try again.
error.pairingNotAvailable: Sending to a computer isn’t available yet. Choose This phone.
error.waitingForTranscription: Finishing the last recording… try again in a moment.
error.sensitiveNeedsTranscript: Sensitive mode needs the live transcript, and this phone can’t make one right now. Turn it off to record.

interrupted.body: Another app took the microphone. Everything up to {{time}} is saved.
interrupted.title: Recording paused

loading.body: Getting transcription ready. This can take a moment.
loading.title: Getting ready

locked.body: Recording continues. The transcript catches up when you open {{app}}.
locked.title: Recording while locked

record.waiting: Lines appear here as people speak.
record.recordOnlyIdle: Recording only on this phone — processed later

recordOnlyWhy.deviceTier: This phone is too old to transcribe. The recording is saved and processed later.
recordOnlyWhy.engineFailed: Transcription stopped working. Recording continues and is processed later.
recordOnlyWhy.modelsMissing: The speech models aren’t downloaded yet. Recording works; download them to transcribe.
recordOnlyWhy.thermal: The phone is too hot to transcribe. Recording continues.

callNotice.steps: Put the call on speakerphone and set the phone down where it can hear everyone. {{app}} records the room.

discard.summaryAudioOnly: This removes the audio only. The transcript and notes stay.
discard.summaryNothing: Nothing was recorded in this stretch yet.
discard.behind: Text still being transcribed for this stretch is dropped too.

calendar.label: From your calendar
calendar.hint: This recording will be named after it.

voice.error: Couldn’t save your voice. Try again, or skip.
voice.errorMicPermission: Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings → {{app}} → Microphone, then try again.
voice.errorRetry: Couldn’t save your voice. Try again.
voice.errorTooQuiet: We could barely hear you. Hold the phone closer and try again.
voice.errorTooShort: That was too short. Read the whole passage, about 20 seconds, then tap Done reading.
voice.levelQuiet: Can’t hear you. Hold the phone closer.
voice.needsModels: Your voice can be added once the speech models are downloaded. You can do it later in Settings.
voice.passage: In our weekly sync we review the roadmap, confirm the budget, and agree on who owns each action item before Friday’s release. Hôm nay mình chốt scope cho bản beta, rồi phân công việc cho từng người. If anything slips, I will flag it early, and we will decide together what to cut.
voice.waitHint: Keep reading. You can finish after {{min}} s.

sensitive.label: Sensitive meeting
sensitive.hint: Only the transcript is kept: no audio is saved, nothing goes to the cloud, no voices are learned.
sensitive.confirmLive: No more audio is kept, and the audio recorded so far is deleted when you stop. Only the transcript stays; cloud AI and voice learning are off. It can’t be turned off during this recording.
sensitive.confirmStored: Its audio is deleted now and only the transcript stays. Cloud AI and voice learning are off for it.
sensitive.failed: Couldn’t change sensitive mode. Try again.
sensitive.noTranscript: There is no transcript to keep yet, so this meeting can’t be made sensitive.
sensitive.pending: This meeting is still being processed from its audio. Try again when it is ready.
